These are deterministic rectangular walk/slash crops from user-provided project source art. Full 832x3456 authoring sheets remain outside dist/. Exact matching upstream license/credit records are not currently present in the project, so these derivatives are DEVELOPMENT-AUTHORIZED / ATTRIBUTION HOLD and must not be treated as commercially cleared until provenance is resolved.

Fleshborn armor overlays reuse previously preserved LPC equipment assets; this release adds no new external armor source.

See docs/ASSET_USAGE_AND_CREDITS.md.
